281649129.description:
Pressed Glass Telegraph Insulator Lot - 2 Pieces
W. Brookfield, CD 145 Beehive Style
Aqua Blue-Green, Antique Circa 1880s-1890s
Pair of authentic antique CD 145 "Beehive" style glass telegraph and telephone insulators manufactured by the W. Brookfield Glass Company of New York. Featuring heavy molded aqua glass construction with a pronounced wire groove, rounded dome crown, and interior threaded petticoat skirt, these classic insulators played a vital role in early American telecommunications and railroad line infrastructure.
Pieces Included:
Brookfield CD 145 Beehive insulator, embossed "W. BROOKFIELD NEW YORK" and "PAT. NOV. 13TH 1883 / FEB. 12TH 1884", aqua glass, approximately 4 inches tall - intact with light base fleabites
Brookfield CD 145 Beehive insulator, matching form with inner petticoat threading, aqua glass, approximately 4 inches tall - intact with minor rim roughness
Condition:
Both insulators are structurally sound with intact crowns, smooth wire tie grooves, and clear internal threading. Base rims display typical light fleabites, minor flaking, and mold seam roughness consistent with authentic vintage field use and age. Glass exhibits characteristic maker inclusions and air bubbles throughout with strong aqua color and gloss.
